_readme: Songs for the Church Live Hosting Program. Replace the sample songs with your own. Each song has a title and sections (each with a label and a list of lines). Optional: composer, author, singer, reference and, for songs from a hymn book, number, book and edition. Sections are shown in the order written. To repeat a chorus without retyping it, give sections an id and add an 'order' list of ids, e.g. "order": ["v1", "c", "v2", "c"]. On the lyrics pages, keys 1-9 jump to 'Verse 1'-'Verse 9' (found from the label, or add "verse": 2 to a section), and C or 0 jumps to the chorus (a section whose label contains 'Chorus' or 'Refrain', or that has "kind": "chorus"). Check commas and quote marks: one missing comma makes the whole file unreadable.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We gather here at the break of day
With open hands and hearts to pray
The light of morning fills the room
And every shadow turns to bloom

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Sing it out, sing it out
Let the whole earth hear
Sing it out, sing it out
Our God is always near

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Through every season, joy and tears
You have been with us all the years
Your faithful word, our steady ground
Where peace and mercy still are found

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: So lift the song and lift it high
Let every voice rise to the sky
One family, one hope, one call
Praise to the Giver of us all

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Where two or three are gathered near
The quiet word is gladly heard
A candle in the evening glow
Shows us the way that we should go

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Give thanks for bread upon the table
Give thanks for those who make us able
To carry burdens, share the load
And walk together on the road

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When night is long and hope is thin
Your steady love will lead us in
And we will rise with the new day
To serve and sing along the way

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come with gladness, come with singing
Bring your thanks and bring your praise
Every heart and every voice
In one chorus now we raise

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Blessed be the name above all names
Blessed be the One who reigns
Blessed be the name above all names
Forever and ever, amen

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Open gates and open doors
Welcome all who come in peace
From the least to the greatest
Let our songs of joy not cease
